children.game_version: circle dance with simplified stepping and call-and-response singing

avoid: stick use if balance is compromised
seniors.standing_version: reduce step length and tempo; support balance with a chair or rail

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Swing in coordination with the body and steps; may hold and rhythmically move sticks.
movement_profile.footwork: Step forward with right foot, then two steps backward with left foot, repeated in a pendulum motion.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers form a circle moving left to right.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Slight swaying matching the pendulum steps.

signature_moves.description: Forward step with right foot followed by two backward steps with left foot.
signature_moves.name: Pendulum Step

signature_moves.description: Rhythmic movement of sticks in time with the steps.
signature_moves.name: Stick Swing

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid fast or erratic movements that disrupt the measured rhythm.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Pendulum-like steady rhythm matching dance steps.
music_profile.sound_description: The music features a continuous drone from the bagpipe with heroic sung ballads, creating a solemn and martial atmosphere that guides the slow, pendulum-like dance steps.
music_profile.vocal_style: Heroic, narrative singing accompanying the dance.

basic_steps: Form a circle with all dancers.
Step forward with the right foot.
Step backward twice with the left foot.
Swing arms and body in rhythm with steps.
If using sticks, move them rhythmically in time with the steps.
teaching.formation: Circular formation moving left to right.
teaching.level_notes: Suitable for all ages; beginners start with basic stepping and arm movements.
teaching.rhythm: Steady, measured pendulum-like rhythm matching the forward and backward steps.
